messages:
maria-cs: Hey team, just triaging a support case — customer says their promo code PROMO2026 isn't applying. They get a 400 with 'code_not_active' even though it should have been live yesterday.

sophie-support: Can you paste the exact API request/response and customer id? I want to confirm it's not a client-side issue.

maria-cs: Repro steps from the customer:
1) POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem
2) body: { "user_id": "U12345", "code": "PROMO2026" }
Response: 400 { "error": "code_not_active", "campaign_id": "camp_987" }

sophie-support: Thanks. @aj-engineer can you check campaign camp_987 config? Maybe start/end dates or region gating.

aj-engineer: Looking now. Quick findings: in admin the campaign shows start: 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z and end: 2026-06-30T23:59:59Z. Customer expected it to be active from 2026-05-01.
Also noticed redemption_limit = 0 (was set accidentally during CSV import). That will block any redemptions regardless of time.

maria-cs: Ugh. Where did the CSV import come from?

aj-engineer: The marketing CSV had empty value for limit. Our import pipeline defaults empty -> 0. Should've been NULL/unlimited.

leo-ops: Two actionable fixes: 1) Update start date to 2026-05-01 if marketing confirms. 2) Set redemption_limit to NULL (or a positive int) in DB. We can do either via admin UI (safer) or run a db patch.

sophie-support: Can marketing confirm desired start and cap? I've pinged them in #marketing.

promo-bot: [automation] campaign camp_987: status=paused, start=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z, limit=0

maria-cs: Marketing replied: they want start=2026-05-01, unlimited redemptions for this campaign.

aj-engineer: OK. Suggestion: apply change through admin UI to avoid running direct SQL. If the UI call is flaky, we can run a safe patch. Proposed SQL (dry-run first):
```sql
-- set unlimited (NULL) and correct start date
UPDATE promo_campaigns
SET redemption_limit = NULL, start_time = '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'
WHERE id = 'camp_987' AND environment = 'prod';
```

leo-ops: I approve a targeted DB change if admin UI fails. We should take a quick backup and run it in a maintenance window — but given customer impact we can do it now with runbook. @sophie-support can you ack to proceed?

sophie-support: Acknowledged. Customer impacted is mid-enterprise on trial, escalated. Approve immediate fix. :white_check_mark:

aj-engineer: Running admin UI update first. If it errors, will run the SQL patch and post logs.

(2m later)

aj-engineer: Admin UI update succeeded — campaign start and limit updated. Hitting the redeem endpoint again with the same payload returns 200 { "redeemed": true, "credits": 100 }.

maria-cs: Passing success to the customer. Thanks everyone.

infra-bot: deploy-ops: config-change recorded by aj-engineer at 2026-05-12T15:42:10Z

promo-bot: [automation] campaign camp_987: status=active, start=2026-05-01T00:00:00Z, limit=NULL

sophie-support: Follow-ups: 1) Add a validation to import pipeline to reject empty numeric limits (or default to NULL). 2) Log an alert when start_time > now + 24h and campaign set to 'active'. @aj-engineer can you file tickets?

aj-engineer: Yep, filing two tickets and will include a small unit test for CSV importer.

maria-cs: Customer confirmed promo worked and they got credits. Closing case. :tada:
